name: SupportAI
postCreateCommand: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build
postStartCommand: cd backend && nohup python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 > /tmp/supportai.log 2>&1 &

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Enables Claude-written answers and the LLM judge.
